articles.title: Shenzhen–Hong Kong–Guangzhou Cluster Named Among World's Top Innovation Hubs in 2026
articles.summary: The World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) released its Global Innovation Index 2026 on 8 September, listing the world's top 100 innovation clusters. The Shenzhen–Hong Kong–Guangzhou region was once again named one of the leading clusters on the list. An innovation cluster is a place where many technology companies, universities, and research centres work closely together to create new inventions and businesses. Being recognised on this list means that the Greater Bay Area continues to be one of the most creative and forward-thinking regions on the planet, helping Hong Kong stay connected to cutting-edge science and technology.

lv1: Which organisation publishes the Global Innovation Index every year? (每年發布《全球創新指數》的是哪個機構？)
Which three cities make up the innovation cluster mentioned in the article? (文章提到的創新集群由哪三個城市組成？)
lv2: Why is it important for Hong Kong to be part of a top-ranked innovation cluster? (香港成為頂尖創新集群的一部分，為什麼重要？)
What kinds of organisations work together inside an innovation cluster, and how do they help each other? (哪些機構在創新集群內合作，它們如何互相幫助？)
lv3: Some people say that Hong Kong should focus more on finance than on technology innovation. Do you agree or disagree, and why? (有人說香港應該更專注金融而非科技創新，你同意嗎？為什麼？)

Innovation clusters often develop in certain cities and not others. What factors do you think make a city a good place for innovation, and does Hong Kong have all of them? (創新集群往往只在部分城市發展，你認為什麼因素令一個城市適合創新？香港是否具備這些條件？)

articles.title: Hong Kong Health Authorities Warn of Severe Flu Case Involving Young Child
articles.summary: Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection (CHP) has reported a serious influenza case involving a five-year-old boy who has a long-term health condition. The child began showing symptoms on 6 September 2026. Health officials are reminding parents and caregivers to watch out for flu symptoms, especially in young children or those with existing medical conditions, as they are at greater risk of becoming seriously ill. Influenza, commonly known as the flu, spreads easily between people through coughing and sneezing. Doctors advise regular handwashing, avoiding crowded places when sick, and getting vaccinated to help prevent the flu from spreading.

lv1: How old is the child who became seriously ill with the flu? (患上嚴重流感的兒童幾歲？)
When did the sick child first show symptoms? (患病兒童何時開始出現症狀？)
lv2: Why are children with long-term health conditions at higher risk from influenza than healthy children? (為什麼有長期病患的兒童比健康兒童更容易受到流感的嚴重影響？)
What steps can schools take to help stop the flu from spreading among students? (學校可以採取哪些措施，幫助阻止流感在學生之間傳播？)
lv3: Some families choose not to vaccinate their children against the flu. What are the possible consequences of this choice for the wider community, and should flu vaccination be made compulsory for schoolchildren? (部分家庭選擇不為子女接種流感疫苗，這對社區有何影響？流感疫苗接種應否成為學童的強制要求？)
Public health warnings can sometimes cause unnecessary panic. How should the government balance keeping the public informed with avoiding fear? (公共衛生警告有時可能引起不必要的恐慌，政府應如何在讓公眾知情與避免恐慌之間取得平衡？)

articles.title: 香港首任行政長官董建華辭世，享年89歲
articles.summary: 香港特別行政區首任行政長官董建華於2026年9月8日晚上安詳離世，享年89歲。董建華於1937年在上海出生，其父為航運業巨頭董浩雲。他於1947年隨家人移居香港，完成中學課程後負笈英國深造。1997年香港回歸後，董建華出任首任行政長官，帶領香港踏入新時代，任期至2005年。其辦公室形容他為人正直，心繫國家，畢生貢獻社會，精神長存人心。

lv1: 董建華是哪一年出生的？
董建華擔任香港首任行政長官是在什麼年份開始的？
lv2: 為什麼1997年對香港來說是一個非常重要的年份？
行政長官在香港政府中擔當什麼角色？
lv3: 有人認為首任行政長官對香港的發展影響深遠，你認為一位領導人最重要的品質是什麼？為什麼？
香港回歸後面對不少挑戰，你認為領導人在面對社會困難時應該如何做決定？

articles.title: PISA 2025成績出爐：91個國家及地區學生學習能力大比拼
articles.summary: 「學生能力國際評估計劃」（PISA）2025年的報告於2026年9月8日正式公布。PISA每三年舉行一次，今次共有91個國家及地區參與，評估約15歲學生在閱讀、數學及科學三個範疇的能力。這項評估讓各地教育機構了解本地學生的學習水平，並與全球比較。結果有助政府制定改善教育的政策，令學校教學更有效。香港一直是PISA的參與地區之一，成績備受國際關注。

lv1: PISA評估計劃每隔多少年舉行一次？
PISA主要評估學生哪三個學習範疇？
lv2: 為什麼各地政府重視PISA的評估結果？這些結果對教育政策有什麼幫助？
為什麼只測試約15歲的學生，而不是測試所有年齡層的學生？
lv3: 有人認為國際排名會令學校過分注重應試，忽略學生的全面發展，你同意嗎？
如果香港在PISA成績下跌，你認為政府、學校和家長各自應該承擔什麼責任？
